arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Stone argued the case falls under the Wartime Suspension of Limitations Act.
Mr. Elwood argued the lower court erred in allowing the fifth complaint.
Mr. Stewart argued Congress enacted the law against a criminal statute backdrop.
Justice Scalia questioned the use of the word pending in the statute.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: The case tests whether a wartime law pauses civil fraud deadlines. The contractor claims the law applies to civil cases. The relator claims the law applies only to criminal cases.
